delivery: One JSON file per chapter; preserve app-compatible questions, options, correctIndex, explanation and explanationHtml fields
audience: MD/DNB Medicine graduates preparing for NEET-SS Medical Group
sequence: Finish one chapter before starting the next. Finish subjects in progress.json subjectOrder.
questionCounts: Determine each chapter's total from a documented map of distinct high-yield concepts and decisions. Do not enforce the original provisional 30/40 targets or imply they reflect official examination weights. Audit existing chapters for coverage gaps before final completion.

questions.distribution: Continuous logical topic progression; no random alternation or unnecessary repeated concepts
questions.difficulty: Clinical reasoning with four closely competing medically plausible alternatives; one defensible best answer
questions.types: Use clinical vignettes where context matters and direct questions for criteria, mechanisms, pharmacology, classification and characteristic findings
questions.avoid: Giveaway wording, unrelated or absurd options, excessive stem length, answer-length cues, obscure trivia and forced vignettes
questions.key: Distribute A–D approximately evenly and independently check questionable keys

explanations.scope: Individualized standalone postgraduate teaching notes, not answer-only rationales or generic filler
explanations.title: Actual medical topic
explanations.headings: Relevant medical headings; do not repeat a heading as the first bold phrase below it
explanations.structure: Genuine nested HTML lists with bold medical concepts; coherent sentences
explanations.tables: Compact specific comparisons, classifications, criteria, scores or doses when useful; do not force tables into every answer
explanations.diagnosis: Relevant criteria, thresholds, confirmation rules, typical findings, differentials and limitations
explanations.treatment: Indications, first-line treatment, exact relevant doses and durations, contraindications, alternatives, monitoring and escalation
explanations.drugs: Mechanism, indications, important adverse effects, interactions, contraindications and comparisons
explanations.distractors: Explain each individually: what it represents, when appropriate and why less suitable here. Numerical calculations instead require formula, substitution, result and clinical interpretation.
explanations.standalone: No deferral to another chapter; include related high-yield material without padding

references: Use established textbooks, authoritative societies, primary trials and systematic reviews. Browse to verify decision-sensitive thresholds, doses, criteria and current guidance. State guideline year, conflicting frameworks and source-access limits honestly. Do not claim independent clinician review.

typography.tables: Thin borders, subtle alternating rows and horizontal scroll wrapper

installation: Add each validated chapter without deleting previously completed chapters. Verify runtime readback and unchanged hashes of other banks. Keep user data and backups out of Git. Commit locally and attempt configured remote push after every install. Record any failure and retain local commits.
